what: In a 600×200 slot centered at 58% of the board height, five cards lie tilted at X 56° · Z −38°, stacked at .85 scale with 34px spacing (lower cards fainter, .55 to 1). They breathe over 3.2s ease-in-out, with cards floating 12·10·8·6px higher starting from the top. When the wheel scrolls down past 10 or swipes up 30px, each card, delayed .04s apiece, spins twice around the Y axis (720°), the tilt unwinds, and it flies to the center of its own slot (target), stretches to that slot’s size and vanishes over .85s power2.out. At .35s the title and the top card’s text fade out over .3s (blur 6px), from .6s the real cards turn on at .04s intervals over .45s, and the title returns at .72s. After expanding, when the inner scroll is at the top and the wheel scrolls up, the cards gather back into the stack in reverse over .9s power3.inOut

options.scroller: Inner scroll panel css to lower after unfolding — locked when dummy, checks here whether it is at the top. Window if none
options.hint: (optional) CSS for a ‹Scroll› hint shown only for the dummy — without it [data-fx-part=hint]
options.dur · back · each · spin: Scatter and gather length (seconds), delay between sections (seconds), rotation angle (degrees), default .85 · .9 · .04 · 720
options.[data-fx-part=deck]: Stack (required) — cards inside, in order from the bottom one
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Dummy cards (required) — the last is on top. The i-th card goes to the i-th target
options.[data-fx-part=target]: Real card that lights up after scattering (grid cell)
options.[data-fx-part=title] · [data-fx-part=cov: (if any) title that switches off and comes back when scattering · text on the top section (fades out)
options.fx:deal · fx:gather · fx:dealt: Sending to the panel scatters or gathers · once fully scattered, it is released from the panel
